profile.headline: Engineer @ NVIDIA
profile.summary: AI maximalist software engineer working on the future of inference.

positions.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead of the Operations team with responsibilities spanning: packaging, CI, infrastructure, developer experience, testing, product integrations, and release management.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development and integration of MTConnect protocol for CNCs and plasma systems across multiple business teams.
Designed and implemented RESTful and GraphQL microservice APIs implemented in JavaScript, Python, and C\# for applying Hypertherm's CAM and plasma process expertise to OEM integrations.
Built a lexical parser for CNC program validation that enabled improved cut process selection and motion planning.
Implemented support for cutting tool firmware updates over EtherCAT from Hypertherm EdgeConnect CNCs.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Controls
positions.description:
Developed a PubSub pipeline using AMQP-compliant cloud infrastructure for cutting system data ingestion and analysis.
Implemented full-stack React web application to port Hypertherm desktop tools to SaaS products.
Established documentation standards and processes for using OpenAPI specifications to rapidly prototype new products.
Introduced CI/CD pipelines for Hypertherm's API product line reducing delivery time from quarterly to a daily.

positions.title: Software Engineer, IoT
positions.description:
Developed edge device software and cloud services to support remote diagnostics, analysis, and optimization of industrial cutting tool product lines using C++, C#, Python, and Javascript.
Established and implemented testing protocols and analysis for evaluating reliability and cut quality impact of increasing load from IoT data streaming on cutting systems and worked across teams to implement solutions.
Designed and implemented REST APIs for legacy software providing state and diagnostics of industrial cutting hardware.
Defined information security best practices for software engineering teams as member of Information Services Security Council.

company.name: Thayer School of Engineering at Dartmouth

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Invented dynamic QR codes for use as a low-cost diagnostic assay platform that utilized a cloud-based, automated image analysis pipeline to determine analyte-of-interest concentration under adverse field conditions.
Developed optimization algorithms for the design of origami-inspired diagnostic devices that minimized the sample volume.
Modelled using COMSOL and optimized parameters of an optoelectrowetting device for the control of droplets using a mobile device screen and animations as the illumination source.
Devised enzyme-catalyzed reactive polymers for analyte-sensitive valves enabling digital logic in paper microfluidic devices.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant and Lecturer in Digital Electronics
positions.description:
Developed and delivered lectures, lesson plans, laboratory assignments, final project materials, and an examination to 50 undergraduates.
Recruited, managed, and participated as a member of a team of teaching assistants in leading laboratory sections and grading assignments.
Recipient of the 2013 Exceptional Teaching Assistant Award.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed a building-scale, internet of things lighting control platform of spectrum-tunable LEDs and discrete wireless sensors.
Prototyped and built a RFID tracking and analysis platform for wardrobe-embedded tags to evaluate the value of mass customized clothing to office-working professionals.
Designed and ran human factors studies on the effects of persuasive technology on energy conservation habits in scenarios of visual discomfort.
